style:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square vocabulary illustration for a Japanese listening game
Style/medium: simple flat cartoon, rounded natural silhouettes, solid fills, clean smooth dark-purple exterior outlines; understated charm. No gradients, 3D, watercolor, paper grain, sketch marks or photorealism.
Palette: ink #3f2468, pink #ff85b5, orange #ff9d47, yellow #ffe178, lavender #af86ef, sky blue #91d7ed, green #a6dbad, warm skin #ffcf9c. White and neutral gray allowed. Factual colors such as flags and named colors override decorative palette.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent outer background with an alpha channel; no painted white backdrop, checkerboard, frame or rounded card border.
Composition/framing: square canvas, primary subject centered and fully visible, typically 65–75 percent of canvas; generous margin. Context is subordinate. Maintain legibility at 145px.
Line system: rounded caps and joins; exterior stroke approximately 7 units on a 256-unit canvas. Keep apparent line weight consistent across single and grouped subjects, simplify detail for small groups; no hairline details below one pixel at 145px.
Constraints: literal recognizable subject, accurate anatomy, exact quantities. No answer captions, translations, decorative badges, logos, watermarks, shadows or unrelated props. Only render text/numerals if explicitly essential to the subject, character, quantity, calendar or factual sign. An attractive mnemonic is not proof of an unambiguous meaning.

Asset type: one square vocabulary illustration for a Japanese listening game
Style/medium: simple flat cartoon, rounded natural silhouettes, solid fills, clean smooth dark-purple exterior outlines; understated charm. No gradients, 3D, watercolor, paper grain, sketch marks or photorealism.
Palette: ink #3f2468, pink #ff85b5, orange #ff9d47, yellow #ffe178, lavender #af86ef, sky blue #91d7ed, green #a6dbad, warm skin #ffcf9c. White and neutral gray allowed. Factual colors such as flags and named colors override decorative palette.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent outer background with an alpha channel; no painted white backdrop, checkerboard, frame or rounded card border.
Composition/framing: square canvas, primary subject centered and fully visible, typically 65–75 percent of canvas; generous margin. Context is subordinate. Maintain legibility at 145px.
Line system: rounded caps and joins; exterior stroke approximately 7 units on a 256-unit canvas. Keep apparent line weight consistent across single and grouped subjects, simplify detail for small groups; no hairline details below one pixel at 145px.
Constraints: literal recognizable subject, accurate anatomy, exact quantities. No answer captions, translations, decorative badges, logos, watermarks, shadows or unrelated props. Only render text/numerals if explicitly essential to the subject, character, quantity, calendar or factual sign. An attractive mnemonic is not proof of an unambiguous meaning.
Primary request: Several circular everyday objects: plate, ball, clock
Review constraints:
- F10: Retain semantic exclusion groups across the whole choice pool, including broader terms versus their specific instances. Synonyms may share an image safely when never posed as competing answers.
Learning limitation: supporting contextual illustration; do not try to encode an abstract or grammatical distinction with arbitrary colors or tiny badges.
User feedback for shared designs (takes priority over obsolete appearance descriptions; retain the intended subject and action):
Shared ball design: an orange basketball at the preferred tilted three-quarter angle, with a clearly visible off-center seam crossing. Keep two main grooves crossing clearly and bowed side channels connecting at separate points; preserve a recognizable basketball junction instead of showing only parallel arcs. Dark-purple exterior outline, slightly narrower purple grooves and broad orange panels. Reuse for ordinary toy/sports balls while preserving intended count, size and spatial relations; keep specifically implied baseballs, beads, marbles, yarn balls and small jar counters appropriate to their own scene. Current v4 reference is accepted provisionally, with an unresolved seam/angle improvement. Do not treat its seams as a finished design standard; retain the improvement note when planning dependent artwork.
Background/export requirement (takes priority over older white-background wording above): genuinely transparent outer background with an alpha channel, never a painted white rectangle or checkerboard. Preserve opaque white subject details such as clouds, snow and animal markings. Keep teaching scenes inside their intended silhouette. Request transparent_background=true from the built-in image tool and retain alpha in PNG or WebP delivery; never flatten to JPEG. Inspect at 145px over white, yellow #fff2c5, pink #fff0f5 and lavender #f6efff before approval; reject rectangular backdrops and edge halos.

No bright white shine streaks, exclamation-shaped glare, photographic texture, watercolor or sketch strokes.

Color: use the reference's warm golden and violet family for decorative accents. Preserve the factual/teaching color of the subject, including yellow banana, blue paint, green shoots and white clouds.
Constraints: correct anatomy, recognizable literal vocabulary subject, no answer labels, words, letters, branding, watermark, frame or decorative extras. Match the visual style rather than copying the cat's subject or background.
